+    },
+    "complement_union_closure": {
+      "status": "PASS",
+      "lemma": "complementFamilyOn_unionClosed_of_functionalPreorder",
+      "assessment": "De Morgan duality on subsets of fixed carrier U: (U \\ S) ∪ (U \\ T) = U \\ (S ∩ T), transferring intersection closure of F to union closure of complementFamilyOn F U."
+    },
+    "cardinality_preservation": {
+      "status": "PASS",
+      "lemma": "complementFamilyOn_card",
+      "assessment": "Map S ↦ U \\ S is an involution on P(U) (sdiff_sdiff_eq_self_of_subset) and thus strictly injective on F; Finset.card_image_iff guarantees |complementFamilyOn F U| = |F|."
+    },
+    "frequency_duality": {
+      "status": "PASS",
+      "lemma": "freq_complementFamilyOn",
+      "assessment": "Element x ∈ U occurs in complement U \\ S if and only if x ∉ S; natural number subtraction |F| - freq(F, x) is exact without truncation error."
+    },
+    "double_counting": {
+      "status": "PASS",
+      "lemma": "sum_card_eq_sum_freq_on",
+      "assessment": "Finite bipartite incidence counting (sum_card_bipartiteAbove_eq_sum_card_bipartiteBelow) independently establishes ∑_{S ∈ F} |S| = ∑_{x ∈ U} freq(F, x)."
+    },
+    "rare_element_extraction": {
+      "status": "PASS",
+      "lemma": "exists_rare_of_averageRare",
+      "assessment": "D004 average rarity (2 * ∑ |S| ≤ |U| * |F|) together with carrier nonemptiness guarantees existence of x ∈ U with 2 * freq(F, x) ≤ |F| by contradiction on summing strict inequalities."
+    },
+    "abundance_transfer": {
+      "status": "PASS",
+      "lemma": "complementFamilyOn_abundant_of_exists_rare",
+      "assessment": "Duality 2 * (|F| - freq(F, x)) ≥ |F| yields 2 * freq(F', x) ≥ |F'|; support membership x ∈ support(F') is witnessed by U = U \\ ∅ ∈ F' since ∅ ∈ F."
+    },
+    "nontriviality": {
+      "status": "PASS",
+      "lemma": "d005_complement_frankl",
+      "assessment": "IsNontrivial is defined as (support F').Nonempty and is directly witnessed by the abundant support element x."
+    }
+  },

+  },
